description.value: Sentry provides error tracking, performance monitoring, session replay, and more to help developers ship better software.
A San Francisco-based application monitoring company that builds an application monitoring and observability platform, which started as an open-source project.

product_description.value: Error tracking, performance monitoring, session replay, and more.
An MCP server, a CLI for querying issues and analyzing errors, and a REST API, plus SDK setup pages for Python and JavaScript.
Error monitoring, session replay, tracing, profiling and release tracking.

customer_description.value: Used by over 4 million developers worldwide; described as an open-source application monitoring platform.
Serves over 4 million developers and 130,000 organizations worldwide; another directory lists 85K customers as of November 2022.

revenue.value: Roughly $70 million to $128 million; Datanyze lists $93.9 million

employees.value: About 180 (Levels.fyi) to 391 (getlatka), with 428 and 447 in other listings

founded_year.value: 2011 (most sources); others say 2012; one notes an earlier 2010 open-source origin

headquarters.value: San Francisco (most sources), with one listing at 45 Fremont St
